api.base_url: n/a (browser upload to presigned object-store URL)

auth.refresh: n/a (user is signed in to portal)

access_requirements.customer_admin_must_do: Export report to CSV or XLSX from their system and upload via portal.

rate_limits: Excel worksheet max 1,048,576 rows by 16,384 columns (Microsoft Excel specifications), so larger CSVs need streaming; OWASP: set upload size limits
data_objects_to_pull: any tabular export mapped by user to a canonical schema
incremental_sync: None native: re-upload; dedupe by row hash or primary-key upsert after column mapping
blockers: CSV/formula injection and zip-bomb risks need controls: OWASP says allow-list extensions, rename files to random IDs server-side, check decompressed size, malware scan
sources: https://cheatsheetseries.owasp.org/cheatsheets/File_Upload_Cheat_Sheet.html — 'List allowed extensions'; 'Generate random identifiers server-side'; size limits; malware scan
